events.title: Demo Patch 1.0.2 | Improvements and Fixes
events.summary: Improvements and FixesHoly Crab we made our first patch for the game and demo! We already got the first batch of your valuable feedback which let us improve Seaworks. Mostly we focused on readability of the game and your guidance in the first minutes. There is more to come so please continue being harsh with us 🙂 Changes that only applies to the yet unreleased main game are marked as such. Your boat needs work. And somewhere out there, beneath the cold northern water, your traps are waiting.
